summary: Single-selection tree view of nested violet-tree-item elements, for hierarchies such as folders or categories.

usage.text: Children are violet-tree-item elements; nest an item inside another to make a branch. Only the tree's direct item children are its root items.
value selects the item whose value matches, or whose label text matches when the item has no value. With no tree value, an item marked selected is used.
change fires on user selection with detail { value, itemId }; setting value from script fires nothing. expanded-change fires only when the user expands or collapses a branch.
It is not form-associated: a form does not receive its value and there is no invalid attribute. Read value or listen for change; error-text shows whenever it is set.
Arrows move focus without selecting; Enter or Space selects. Right expands or enters a branch, Left collapses or goes to the parent, Home and End jump, typed letters find an item.

a11y.text: Name it with label or aria-label; with neither it is named "Tree". When label is set, aria-label is ignored.
